تنتدبي (form VIII)
# تَنْتَدِبِي (tantadibī) /tan.ta.di.biː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَدَبَ (intadaba)
# تُنْتَدَبِي (tuntadabī) /tun.ta.da.biː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَدَبَ (intadaba)
